notes.title: Community Update: What's coming next...
notes.content:
Hello witches,

We wanted to give you a little update on the latest with REKA! Things have been quiet recently while we've been working hard on the next chapter of our game, so we thought we'd let you know what to expect! 

[h3][b]Our next big content update will be coming in October[/b][/h3]

Alongside the new content (a little hint for you... it may or may not involve [b]speaking to ghosts[/b]!), we will have fixed [b]many of the most reported bugs[/b]. We want to thank everyone who has been using the bug report form, this has been amazing at helping us track the issues you've been experiencing.

We'll share more about the October update in a couple weeks (we're just fine-tuning things) and we can't wait to show you what's headed to the woodlands. 

Thank you so much for all your patience. We feel very lucky to have such a wonderful community! 

[h3][b][url=https://discord.gg/9D3rYNAWDN]Join our Discord for the Autumn Arts Competition![/url][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/a14e15642e547b781c63508bb0af8ec8aeabef73.png[/img]

Leaves are turning brown, pumpkins are coming back, evenings are getting cozier, the craving for warm drinks has kicked in... Autumn is almost here! To celebrate the most wonderful season of the year, [b]we're running an Autumn Arts competition[/b]!

Until November 3rd, you can submit your seasonal artwork! Any medium and style is accepted, whether you've drawn something seasonal, made a crochet mushroom, painted a flower pot, we are eager to see your wonderful creations!

Prizes include REKA goodies for the runner up and an autumnal-themed prize for the winner!

[url=https://discord.gg/ZC7vSXD2fG][b]You can join the Discord here to take part[/b][/url] (or to browse the incredible entries!)

Talk soon x

notes.title: Community Update: What have we been working on?
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 🧙‍♀️

Is anyone else super excited for autumn? As much as we've been enjoying the warmer weather, we can't wait for crunchy red and gold leaves and cozy evenings in with candles and pumpkins and lots of good books!
 
While getting ready for the best season of the year is something we're very passionate about, we're also focused on our next REKA update. Behind the scenes we've been cracking on with all things witchy, and [b]there's still some finishing touches to go before we're ready to launch our next big update[/b], but we did want to share something we've been working on.

[h3][b]A new workstation is coming to REKA! [/b][/h3]
 
We know how much you love building your chicken-legged homes (we do too!), and we wanted to make it even more enjoyable for you. So, we've been working on a new workstation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/11c8056b175253fdb58fefb424eb1dd41ef225fc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Dreamy garden inspiration [/b][/h3]

We recently ran a[b] Garden of the Witch[/b] competition over on our [url=https://discord.gg/MmqSgpQ5A5][b]Discord[/b][/url] and we saw some absolutely stunning entries. If anyone needs any ideas on how to spruce up their witchy garden, look no further! A big shout out to our Discord community's endless creativity. <3

Our Discord is such a wholesome and welcoming place to be, from sharing recipes and book recommendations, to helping players with REKA quests, this is the perfect inclusive community for all things witchy. notes.title: Community Update: Sneak peeks & more!
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 

Summer solstice has arrived and warmer weather is now in full swing. With bees buzzing and flowers blooming, we wanted to give you a little update on the gardening content and what we're currently working on. ❤️

[h2][b]The Curious Case of the Little Straw Doll 🌾[/b][/h2]

Firstly, we noticed a few comments about the straw doll not working properly. We've looked into this and [b]believe we have made a fix[/b]. This will need a bit more polishing down the line (we will explain below!), but for now it should work as intended.

Thank you SO much for bearing with us through these bugs. We're working as hard as we can to investigate issues as well as focus on new content, so sometimes things do take a little longer than we'd hope. 

The Little Straw Doll will work if you place the item into a pot or flower bed and will prevent your crops from rotting/growing any further. [b]One important thing to note, if you want to move the straw doll to a different flower bed, you'll need to store it first.[/b] Otherwise, you can move it to a different location but the original flower bed will still be protected from rot. So please store the straw dolls before you move them. (We will work on ironing that out a little later down the line!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/e3332ca25974af7800b01a4a9c2eabf09988f52d.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What's the latest?[/b][/h2]

We've been concentrating on new content and what's coming next to the woodlands. While there's a few more things we need to finalise before we can fully announce what's headed to the witchy world of REKA, we did want to show off these two items we hope you'll love: 

[h3][b]Flower crown [/b][/h3]

We've been working on this flower crown to give you more options when it comes to character customisation. We wanted to stick to the nature themes and give Reka something beautifully autumnal to wear upon their head! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/d008e822606058d11e8429f63e5993e38fb44746.png[/img]

[h3][b]Candle with a special purpose... [/b][/h3]

This has been really fun to create. You'll be able to use this candle to help spirits pass over to the afterlife. But we'll share more on this a little later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/992762dcabeb5c8ae9add2d9797355a5e0164f9b.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Garden of the Witch Competition[/b][/h2]

Over on our [url=https://discord.gg/MmqSgpQ5A5][b]official REKA Discord[/b][/url], we're hosting a gardening build competition. The prizes include a REKA t-shirt and a gardening-themed gift, and we're really looking forward to seeing all the entries! We usually always have some sort of competition running on our Discord, from house builds to writing short stories, and even art and cooking themed challenges! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/3d3479bf96c76adc3e1e6d3033ea4ff9d47841e6.png[/img]


[b]There's a few other reasons to join our wonderful community too:
[/b]
[list]
[*]An [b]inclusive space[/b] to chat with likeminded people about ALL things witchy! 
[*]Share [b]tips and tricks[/b] about REKA, ask other players for help and share your wisdom.
[*]From recipes to sewing projects, cute pictures of cats and book recommendations, there's channels for loads of [b]hobbies and interests[/b], and we love to chat about all of them!
[*]Chat to the [b]team behind REKA[/b]. While we're always active on Steam and our other socials, Discord is where you can see more behind-the-scenes and share your feedback directly with the dev group. 
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/MmqSgpQ5A5][b]You can join us on Discord using this link![/b][/url]

[h2][b]Inspiration for your chicken-legged cottage[/b][/h2]

Just getting started with your witchy home? Or looking for some ideas on how to take your cozy retreat to the next level? We've seen some fantastic designs on Discord that we wanted to share with you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/b9fc1716a76a5b16dfd261217b25cf8dfa746f81.jpg[/img]
[i]Turn your attic into the perfect place to grow your plants by using ladders in the roof. 🌱[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/830a5065e056d35926e3adcd72159eb4699a0689.jpg[/img]
[i]Not just the legs... Go one step further and commit to the whole chicken! 🐔[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/a9a32307fe58a0f4b1bd3862ffeb198e79316203.png[/img]
[i]A witch's garden isn't complete without carefully placed candles. 🕯️[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/ca044b72bfce3e8753c02ef25b982637e26d5646.jpg[/img]
[i]This is literally what our dream home looks like. ✨[/i]

[h2][b]Win one of 50 Tales of Seikyu keys![/b][/h2]

Finally, before we jump off, we wanted to let you know about our friends over at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340520/Tales_of_Seikyu/][b]Tales of Seikyu[/b][/url]. Tales of Seikyu is a cozy life sim where you can farm, decorate your home, explore the magical island, and find true love! If that sounds like your sort of game, they're giving away 50 keys to those who are subscribed to the Fireshine Games newsletter using this link: [url=https://bit.ly/TalesofSeikyuGiveaway  ][b]https://bit.ly/TalesofSeikyuGiveaway[/b][/url]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/c8fedf1a6a50009c698a8d2a1001758a3c334a4c.jpg[/img]

The cut off is 9th July, so if you'd like to be in with a chance of winning a key, do sign up using the link above! 

Thanks so much for all your ongoing support. We'll share more with you very soon!

notes.title: Roots & Remedies Update Patch is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, witches!

[b]Our Roots & Remedies Update Patch [/b]has been moved onto the [b]main branch[/b] and is now ready for everybody to play!

This patch features lots of fixes and polishes that should make your time in the woodlands even more enjoyable! Thanks so much to everyone who tested this update on the Beta branch, it was super helpful.

You can read more on what's coming to the patch below, but first we'd like to mention a few important points: 

[b]Siva Shrine:[/b] If you are on 'Becoming the Herbal Witch' but you still have an unfinished Siva shrine on your map, you can just travel to the next map. You have already completed it and don't need to do it again.
Or if you'd like to go with a save file where you haven't completed the shrine yet, talking to Baba Jaga will often help complete the quest.

[b]Button Mapping:[/b] We have gotten reports of Button Mapping Settings changing randomly. If you are experiencing issues where some keys don't do what there supposed to please let us know and reset your Button Mapping Settings if needed.

[b]Optimisation:[/b] From what players have reported, [b]it should mostly be the first map in the tutorial of the game that is suffering with frame rate issues.[/b] This is unfortunate and we apologize, but from the second map onwards our testers have experienced the game running normally. We will continue to investigate ways to fix this, and want to thank you all for bearing with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/b46daf78748ac82dde2d902d9317f8a2ef41ad1b.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Latest updates:[/b][/h1]

[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*]The time since the last save is now displayed in the pause screen.[/list]

[*]The collection will now only be loaded in when you click on the collection button, or your journal was previously closed while looking at the collection
[*]Improved performance of the pine stick cleanse VFX
[*]Improved performance of the chimney smoke VFX
[*]Improved performance when switching use items
[*]Post Processing performance optimization
[*]Implemented distance based animation frame throttling. Far away characters or animals now play their animations on a lower framerate, reducing load on the GPU [/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3] [list]
[*]Fixed Terrain sinking resulting in floating assets
[*]Fixed Terrain rising resulting in buried assets
[*]Fixed Lumberjacks vanishing from Trial of the Forest Spirit Clearing
[*]Fixed Lantern and/or Pine Branch being stuck in Hand
[*]Fixed watering can disappearing
[*]Fixed Tutorial prompts that are in the level not rotating towards camera
[*]Fixed Cursor resetting to the center of the screen after every dialogue option
[*]Disabled quick-saving during dialogues or popups, which was the cause for a lot of broken save games. The game will now display “ cannot save right now” in those cases.
[*]Made it impossible for some dialogues to interrupt others in rare cases leading to unresponsive NPCs
[*]Improved consistency of saving for POIs
[*]Confirming a popup doesn't advance dialogue anymore
[*]Fixed some sound issues
[*]Fixed someone saying: “Chapter_Harvest_SidePOI/Artist/Weather/NoWind_02”
[*]Fixed the animation for the charm during the Tutorial Ritual not functioning properly
[*]Fixed some loot sacks not being interactable
[*]Fixed some Honeycombs not being collectable
[*]Fixed cursed object interaction being visible too early
[*]Removed the mysterious floating pantry in the woods
[*]Fixed navigation issues for settings sliders with controller
[*]Fixed a variety of items (Some that you couldn’t place, Some that you couldn’t pick up)
[*]Moved some items into the right categories
[*]Fixed the Toilet not opening
[*]Fixed the Home Cleansing point of interest. Players should now be able to properly cleanse the [*]home with a pine stick to reveal the black salt corners.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to be stuck in the zoomed in mode of the bird use item, if the “Toggle Aim” option was turned on.
[*]Added an additional safety to make Leshy appear at the tree when you collect one of the cones, if he hasn’t appeared yet
[*]Fixed green apple
[*]Fixed travel screen appearing empty
[*]Fixed Leshy deer journal log appearing on later maps
[*]Fixed saving for plants at siva poi
[*]Fixed edge case where players watered plants before Baba Jaga told them to[/list]

As always, if you spot anything that doesn't look quite right, please do fill out our bug form: [url=https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/242213662397357][b]https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/242213662397357[/b][/url]

Thanks for all your support. Talk soon!

[list]

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed [b]Terrain sinking[/b] resulting in floating assets
[*]Fixed [b]Terrain rising[/b] resulting in buried assets
[*]Fixed [b]Lumberjacks vanishing[/b] from Trial of the Forest Spirit Clearing
[*]Fixed [b]Lantern and/or Pine Branch[/b] being stuck in Hand
[*]Fixed [b]watering can[/b] disappearing
[*]Fixed [b]Tutorial prompts[/b] that are in the level not rotating towards camera
[*]Fixed [b]Cursor resetting[/b] to the center of the screen after every dialogue option
[*][b]Disabled quick-saving during dialogues[/b] or popups, which was the cause for a lot of broken save games. The game will now display “ cannot save right now” in those cases. 
[*]Made it[b] impossible for some dialogues to interrupt others[/b] in rare cases leading to unresponsive NPCs
[*]Improved consistency of [b]saving for POIs [/b]
[*][b]Confirming a popup[/b] doesn't advance dialogue anymore
[*]Fixed some[b] sound issues[/b]
[*]Fixed someone saying:[b] “Chapter_Harvest_SidePOI/Artist/Weather/NoWind_02”[/b]
[*]Fixed the [b]animation for the charm[/b] during the Tutorial Ritual not functioning properly
[*]Fixed some [b]loot sacks[/b] not being interactable
[*]Fixed some [b]Honeycombs[/b] not being collectable

[h2][b]
Here's how to access the Beta branch:[/b][/h2]

- Right-click REKA in your Steam library and select Properties.,
- Select the BETAS tab.,
- Enter the code [b]REKAopenBeta[/b] and click the Check Code button.,
- Choose REKA Open Beta from the dropdown.,
- Update the game and enjoy!

[h3][b]NOTE: We'd recommend back up your saves before using the Beta branch: [/b][/h3]

C:\Users\YOUR USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\RekaGame\Saves\YOUR STEAM ID\

- [b]Back up your save:[/b]  Make a copy of the save folder and paste it somewhere safe (e.g., your desktop).,

Speak soon!

notes.title: Dev Update: Upcoming Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 

We just wanted to jump on here and firstly say a big thank you to everyone who has left us feedback since our [b]Roots & Remedies Update[/b] launched. It's been really helpful in pointing us in the right direction of where we should be focusing our efforts. 

With your feedback we have already[b] fixed the crows not collecting wood[/b], so please do continue to let us know if you spot anything odd! ([url=https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/242213662397357][b]Click here to use our Bug Report form[/b][/url])

[h3][b]So, what's next for REKA? [/b][/h3]

Our goal is for REKA to be a relaxing and immersive experience, and a game where you can escape and live your witchy life in the woodlands with your chicken-legged home. [b]It's so important to us that REKA is an enjoyable experience for everyone[/b], and we're taking your reviews and comments very seriously. 

While adding more content and story to REKA is still very much part of our plan for Early Access and beyond, we're going to be spending some time polishing and bug fixing to ensure you can play the game with as few hiccups as possible. 

[h3][b]Coming to our next patch, we're aiming to have ironed out:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed terrain level - No more floating or sunken assets!  
[*] Fixed items like the Pine Branch and Lantern getting stuck in hand 
[*] Fixed Lumberjacks vanishing from Trial of the Forest Spirit Clearing
[*] Drastically reduced time and resources needed at the beginning of the game when loading dependencies[b] (This should help players who were having issues loading the game)[/b]
[*] Drastically reduced time taken to open the Journal, as well as a couple other journal tweaks. [/list]

[h3][b]The latest with optimization  [/b][/h3]

We hear you. Throughout our journey developing REKA, optimization has presented us with a few unforeseen challenges. We've been working through this, but there is a much bigger problem which is causing performance issues with the first map.

From what players have reported,[b] it should only be the first map in the tutorial of the game that is suffering with frame rate issues. [/b]This is unfortunate and we apologize, but[b] from the second map onwards our testers have experienced the game running normally[/b]. We will continue to investigate ways to fix this, and want to thank you all for bearing with us! 

We're hoping to have this patch ready by end of next week, and we'll share more with you very soon. Thanks so much for all your support <3

notes.title: The Roots & Remedies Update is Out Now!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nZ4mx8sk4a][b]Head over to our Discord server[/b][/url] to chat about REKA, your favourite books, share photos of nature, chat about pets, share recipes and more!

notes.content:
Here's the latest changes that have been added to the Beta branch for you to test. Thank you! <3

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Optimized the way points of interest spawn, so that they are distributed further apart on the map

[b]Performance:[/b]
- Slightly improved RAM usage by destroying submeshes of paths that are no longer necessary after the environment generation is completed
- Added  “Quadtree Culling” a system that disables Meshes based on distance and where the player is looking
- Decreased size of Save Files so new saves you create from now on will load faster
- Added new Performance Settings
* Cloth Simulation Quality
* Render Distance
(Note: This will only take effect if you set it from the menu, restart the game or travel to another area.)
* Grass Distance
* Grass Density
* Reimplemented Dynamic Resolution Settings
* Implemented point light culling at 50m

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed Button Remapping not working with controller
- Fixed various bugs in the button remapping screen
- Fixed the loot you receive from bludnik shrine only being fly agaric mushroom after a while
- Fixed Raven Coat and other wearables vanishing (it should reappear if you have completed the quest)
- Fixed a bug where you sometimes couldn’t walk through your doors in the chicken hut
- Fixed a bug that caused the screen to flicker, when near the mirror
- Fixed spamming Escape while jumping forward freezing the game
- Fixed outfit “Layered Burgundy Gown With Lace Accents” missing arm decorations
- Fixed outfit “Layered Burgundy Gown With Lace Accents” sleeves clipping through some coats
- Removed deprecated Hairstyle “Two short braids”. If you have previously selected this hairstyle, you will now be bald and can choose a new hairstyle at the mirror
- Removed deprecated shoes slippers. If you have previously selected these shoes, you will now be barefoot and can change your shoes at the mirror
- Fixed a bug that would cause paths to lower the terrain under Points of Interest, causing some objects to float
- The “three crowns” and “plon” book now have the correct icons when receiving them or viewing them in the building UI
- The “sparkling” effect will now properly fade until no longer visible over some distance
- Fixed a bug that could cause multiple Points of Interests to spawn on top of each other
- Fixed Candle Maker behaving weirdly, swallowing items, or not working at all
- Fixed not getting your wax back when storing a candlemaker
- Made error message when you cant store something more apparent
- Fixed a bug that would cause the grass to jitter, when standing on it for longer than 15 seconds
- Fixed the collisions between the Abandoned Mirror Point of Interest and the Chicken Legged Cottage. - You can no longer walk through the building with your chicken legged cottage
- Fixed a bug that could cause two babushkas to spawn in the same place, making it impossible to interact with one of them
- Fixed a bug where players could add more than 1 item to bludnik shrine
- Guidance popups for active quest, travelling and cooking will now not show again after loading a save if you have seen them already.
- Fixed a variety of saving & quest bugs
- Fixed not being able to cleanse the graveyard after saving and loading in tutorial.
- Fixed a saving bug in the Forgetful Villager Quest
- Fixed the deer group not saving correctly
- Fixed the mirror reflection causing flickering
- Fixed a bug that caused villagers heads to disappear
- Fixed a bug that would cause the “Pick Up” prompt to remain, when bringing a hare home, resulting in the carry animation to break when interacting with it.
- Fixed a bug that caused the player to not get a pine branch from a crooked pine while also removing the branch from the tree, if their inventory was full.
- Fixed being able to double dip on the lutkis. You now have to decide whether to do the offering or take back the loghive.
- Fixed behavior of the merchant’s scale
- Fixed various bugs concerning the villagers requesting food

notes.title: An important update about REKA!
notes.content:
Hello, witches!

We hope you are all keeping well and enjoying the winter season. ❤️

We wanted to give you a little update on where we’re at with our bug fixes and a little insight into the future of REKA. We know so many of you are eager to find out what’s coming next and we want to be as transparent as possible with what to expect. 

[h2][b]Bug fixing and optimisation: [/b][/h2]
As you know, we are working on the fixes for the Halloween update as well as general optimisation issues. The good news is that we’ve sorted the issues you were experiencing with The Witching Hour (including the Bludnik only giving mushrooms as rewards and the candle making table will be easier to use!). 

Unfortunately, we can’t release this patch as soon as we’d hoped. We were aiming to release this patch by the end of the year, however while we were making all these fixes and improvements, we found a much bigger optimisation issue which we need to address before releasing any patches. Fixing this bigger issue will make future game updates much easier for us to implement, as well as improving the overall optimisation and health of REKA. 

With this in mind, [b]the next patch will be coming in January[/b]. We’re so sorry for any disappointment this causes, but please know we are working super hard to fix this. We are a small dev team so it takes a little longer for us to investigate issues and figure out how to fix things – but we’re so close to getting to the bottom of this now! 

[h2][b]A look into the future:[/b][/h2]
Your feedback has been so helpful to us since our launch into Early Access. Reading through all your comments and reviews has shown us what’s important to you and where we should be putting more content into REKA. We’ve decided to make changes to our roadmap to reflect features you’ve been requesting. 

We’ll be able to share more with you in the new year, but we wanted to let you know about a feature we’re very excited about and currently working on… 

In 2025 a big content update will be coming to REKA, and it will include [b]gardening[/b]! Gardening is something that fits perfectly into the cozy vibes of our game and we can’t wait to see how creative you can be with it. 👨‍🌾✂️🌳

Thank you so much for bearing with us through everything, your support has been amazing and we’re feeling so positive about the future of REKA. 

Any questions please let us know and we’ll do our best to answer! Many thanks ❤️

Emberstorm x

notes.title: The Witching Hour - Bug update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thanks so much for your feedback and comments since [b]The Witching Hour update[/b] launched last month. We’ve been reading all your messages and wanted to update you on an issue we’ve noticed occurring.

It seems many of you are unable to access all the new items from the Bludnik, and that after a while all you receive from them is the fly agaric mushrooms. We’re really sorry about this – [b]this is indeed a bug! [/b]🍄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/e57218fa76b95f955b07931468a7e253c928a60f.png[/img]

We are investigating what’s causing this and will be working on a fix to make sure you’ll be able to receive all the items from the Bludnik, but we may need a little time to isolate the problem.

notes.title: REKA Update - 8th of October - V0.1.136.422387
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve combined two previous [b]Open Beta updates[/b] into [b]one comprehensive patch[/b] to make sure you’re all up to date with the latest changes and fixes. This update includes improvements from both patches, so if you’ve missed anything along the way, you can catch up now!

Check out the full details below, and as always, thank you for all the feedback and support in helping us make REKA the best it can be!

[h3][b]Back up your save![/b][/h3]
We also want to encourage everyone to back up any existing save files from the previous version just to be safe. You can do that by following the steps seen below;

[b]- Create a save file:[/b] Start the game and manually save. You can find your saves by pressing WindowsKey+R and then typing in %AppData%\RekaGame\Saves and pressing ok.

[b]- Back up your save: [/b]Make a copy of the save folder and paste it in a safe location, like your desktop or another folder.

[b]- Restore if needed: [/b]If you encounter any issues after installing the latest patch, simply replace the new save files with the backup you made.

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Your chicken hut’s feather color is now saved. For older save games, you’ll see a popup allowing you to restore your chosen feather color.
[*] The chicken legged cottage can no longer move outside of the map borders. (if you have an existing save file where your chicken legged cottage is outside of these border then it will now teleport to be within the map borders when you next open the game).
[*] Added a notification to let the player know that their inventory is full.
[*] Made it slightly harder to gain Leshy's approval.[spoiler]Destroying a singular highstand will no longer count towards increasing Leshy's approval[/spoiler]
[*] While moving your chicken legged cottage, you will now no longer be teleported away from zones that it is not allowed to settle in, instead you will now be blocked from moving within the radius
[*] Added a Button to the Pause Menu that will regenerate the current map if you are stuck at any point and cannot progress. Pressing this button resets your quest progress on the current map (but not your character, house or inventory).
[*] Goats are now less chatty while at home.[/list]
[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3][list]
[*] We have begun reworking how assets are handled in runtime. This will cause a new, short loading screen to appear when starting up the game.
[*] Decreased memory usage by optimizing the loading and unloading of resources, which will slightly increase map generation time. [/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the "Critical Bug - envGenFail" error message.
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow trees to clip through your chicken legged cottage after loading.
[*] Fixed a bug that falsely allowed the player to enter build mode when not at home.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused time to not pass after sleeping in a bed.
[*] Fixed missing translations & grammar/spelling mistakes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a progression lock during the [spoiler]trial of the forest spirit quest when deciding the lumberjacks fate[/spoiler]
[*] Removed a sound that remains near the cottage on the tutorial map after the [spoiler]chicken cottage ritual.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed chests emptying upon loading.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Baba Jaga’s[/spoiler] chest glittering when empty.
[*] Fixed quests involving cleansing being unable to complete if you already knew how to cleanse prior to reaching the map.
[*] Fixed various bugs surrounding the pantry quests.
[*] Controller: Fixed navigation issues with the sap basin UI at the [spoiler]big larch.[/spoiler] [/list]

notes.title: Community Update: REKA demo & FAQs
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We just wanted to jump on here and let you know that our demo is back for the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! We've been tweaking the demo and fixing bugs that have been spotted, but if you do notice anything that doesn't quite work right please do let us know. 🧡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/65f99433f4eb89a14fdcad1c460171a3c4c58554.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Build your chicken-legged home![/b][/h3]

Our demo lets you[b] explore the first section of REKA[/b], where you can venture out into the mysterious woodlands, meet the legendary witch, Baba Jaga, and begin to build and decorate your very own chicken-legged hut. 🐔 

Having our demo live is always such an exciting experience for us as we love reading through your comments. To keep things all in one place and to make it a little easier for you, [b]we wanted to cover off some questions we've seen popping up recently[/b]...

[h3][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/h3] 

[b]When is REKA launching?[/b]
Announced during the [b]PC Gaming Show[/b], our new trailer revealed that REKA is launching in August. This is a little later than we had originally planned, but we wanted to make sure we had enough time to polish our game and implement important feedback we received from our playtests. Thank you so much for your ongoing support, we can't wait to finally show you more of our game! 🍄

[b]Will REKA have Steam Deck support?[/b]
We don't have official Steam Deck support yet, but this is something we are looking into for Early Access. We can't say for sure whether this is something we will have Day 1 for launch, but this is ideally what we are working towards. 

[b]Will there be voice acting?[/b]
Voice acting is not currently planned. We're always open to hearing community requests, however voice acting would be a pretty big one for us to do as a small indie studio. We've been focusing our efforts on the exploration and house-building aspects of REKA, and we hope that the world will still feel immersive without VO. 

[b]Can we stream the demo?[/b]
Yes, please feel free to make content from the demo. Unless it's a closed playtest, we're happy for you to stream our game. 🔮

[b]There's optimisation issues with the demo, are these being fixed?[/b]
We're aware of the problems with optimisation, and thank you so much for flagging them! Optimisation is a big focus for us in the run up to launch, and our team is working hard to iron out these issues and make improvements. 

[b]Is the demo localised?[/b]
Our demo is not localised at the moment. We're still working through translations, and currently our demo is only playable in English. Very sorry if you're unable to play because of this. 

[b]What languages will REKA be localised in?[/b]
For Early Access, REKA will be playable in English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, and Ukrainian.

[b]Will there be controller support?[/b]
Controller support is something we are working on, and ideally hoping to have ready for Early Access. We will keep you updated with our progress on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/c3f2556d0ef549f4ed6a51876311d9fe6fd0755e.gif[/img]

If you have any other questions, please do let us know and we'll do our best to answer. <3

Thanks so much for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Dev Update: Camera Angles & NPCs
notes.content:
Hello witches! 👋

We just wanted to pop on here and give you another little update on what we've been working on. Before we start, we just wanted to say a [b][u]BIG[/u][/b] thank you to everyone who has wishlisted REKA. Your support is really helping our game get noticed, and as a small dev team this community is so important to us.  🧡

[h3][b]Camera Angles & NPCs [/b][/h3]

This is all a work-in-progress, but we’ve been experimenting with different animations. When you speak to a villager they’ll turn around and face you, and we’ve also added in some [b]talking gestures[/b] and [b]hand movements[/b] too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/3dce96197bb50f7ebf392b1921c4edbb59dc7f01.gif[/img]

We’re hoping this will help players feel more immersed in the world of REKA, and we’ve had so much fun adding these little actions in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/75e1c1dcc273be6d56ee80acf66279fde732b0a7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]We have something exciting to share very soon...
[/b][/h3]
You might also notice a little hint at another feature in these screenshots: [b]character customization[/b]! We’ll be showing more on this in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/cd137a8953ddb38f34cd068a3f0bdc2ac0fa979b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Mini FAQs! [/b][/h3]
We'd like to cover off another question we've seen come up quite regularly... The name Reka! 

[b]Why did you choose the name Reka? [/b]

The name first popped up on our radar because the Spree river that runs through Berlin was often called Reka by the local Slavic people, which means 'river'. We have taken on that name and included it into the story, you are basically travelling along a river network throughout the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/3ecb4e5aa4c9ecbdc5907947f23824a45c4eafd2.png[/img]

If you'd like to hear about the latest REKA updates and chat with our wonderful witchy community, [url=https://discord.gg/ahaptqw2VZ][b]join us on Discord here[/b][/url]. 

Thanks for reading, we'll catch you next time!
